# Quaternius Animal Pack Vol. 2 · Eagle

Animated Eagle selection from Animal Pack Vol. 2 by Quaternius.

- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly
- Author: Quaternius
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal / public domain dedication
- Runtime format: FBX
- Included clips: `Eagle|Idle`, `EagleArmature|Idle`,
  `EagleArmature|Flying`

The same rig is temporarily art-directed at different scales and material
tints for raven, crow and eagle. Their ecosystem ids and presentation seam are
separate, so dedicated authored raven/crow models can replace it later without
changing simulation data.
